name: No Rest for Thieves Outreach

creator_name.description: Published preferred/display name, falling back to the actual username/channel name; never invent a personal name.

channel_name.description: Actual channel name; preserve the approved fixed pitch wording outside variables.

reference_work.description: Actual referenced game or video supported by saved creator evidence; do not invent coverage.

specific_observation.description: One or two complete, naturally phrased sentences, including punctuation, connecting the referenced game/video to No Rest for Thieves through evidenced gameplay, style or audience fit. No fixed 'I loved how you' opening; distinguish inference from facts and do not invent viewing claims.

subject: Demo Invitation: No rest for Thieves- A Loot-Splitting Party Game
text:
Hi ${creator_name},

I'm Michael from the team behind No Rest for Thieves, a four-player party game.

I've been following ${channel_name}, and I especially enjoyed your video on ${reference_work}. ${specific_observation} I think our game could be a fun fit for your channel!

I'd love to invite you to try our demo, which is now available on Steam:

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5124600/No_Rest_for_Thieves/

About the Game

No Rest for Thieves is a first-person party game for four players, inspired by the multiplayer trickery of Liar's Bar and the action mechanics of Party Animal.

After a successful heist, split the loot—or steal your friends' shares! But beware: fall asleep, and you'll lose your money!

Use crazy gadgets to stay awake and put your rivals to sleep. Whoever ends up with the most valuable loot wins!

A Note from the Developers

This is an early demo focused on our core gameplay mechanics, we are currently looking for honest feedback, not sponsored coverage or a guaranteed video. We'd love to hear what you think!

If you decide to create any content, we'd love to know your planned release date and check out your video or stream once it's live.

Thanks for your time, and hope you enjoy the demo!

Best regards,

Michael
No Rest for Thieves Team
